h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jodhpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jodhpur

c: Sand storms are part of the year in Jodhpur, on the edge of the Thar, and fine sand finds its way into every moving joint. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, hotels, defence colonies, housing societies and public parks in Jodhpur. The machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 770 km away, and come to western Rajasthan by road.

Good placement and simple care keep a desert-town gym working well. A wall, hedge or building on the windward side cuts the sand that reaches the machines. Our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes each one on a grouted base, which suits the dry, sandy soil. Tell us where the wind usually comes from and send photos of the site. We will place the stations on a layout drawing with that in mind.

items.q: Will sand damage outdoor gym machines in Jodhpur?
items.a: Sand does not harm the galvanised frames, but it can make pivots stiff. Wipe and rinse moving parts after storms and follow the care steps we give you.

items.q: How are the machines fixed on sandy soil?
items.a: We grout each base in a concrete footing, which holds well in dry, sandy ground. The layout drawing shows the position of each footing.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Jodhpur?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory by road and install with our own team or a dealer in north India.
